proposals.before: Boyan soon had his son Dalima put to death and sent Yilianzhenban into exile on Hainan.
proposals.after: Boyan soon had Yilianzhenban's son Dalima put to death and sent Yilianzhenban into exile on Hainan.
proposals.reason: Chinese 其子指亦憐真班之子答裡麻（後文列其子九人長答裡麻），英文 his son 誤屬伯顏。

proposals.before: Soon he killed his son Dalima and banished him to Hainan.
proposals.after: Soon he killed Yilianzhenban's son Dalima and banished Yilianzhenban to Hainan.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise leaves 其子/謫置 referent ambiguous; source makes Dalima Yilianzhenban's son and exile of Yilianzhenban.

proposals.before: Early in the Taiding reign he was made Zishan Grand Physician and Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Regalia.
proposals.after: Early in the Taiding reign he was made Zishan Grandee and Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Regalia.
proposals.reason: 資善大夫 is a civil prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.

proposals.before: Early in the Zhishun reign he was made Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Ronglu Grand Physician, then Commissioner of Meritorious Achievements, retaining his position as commander.
proposals.after: Early in the Zhishun reign he was made Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Ronglu Grandee, then Commissioner of Meritorious Achievements, retaining his position as commander.
proposals.reason: 榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.

proposals.before: He was made Zishan Grand Physician and Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
proposals.after: He was made Zishan Grandee and Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
proposals.reason: 資善大夫 is a prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.

proposals.before: He was promoted to first rank as Ronglu Grand Physician.
proposals.after: He was promoted to first rank as Ronglu Grandee.
proposals.reason: 榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.

proposals.before: In the winter of 1363 he was made Garrison Commander of Shangdu and concurrently Prefect of Kaiping, promoted to Ronglu Grand Physician, and charged with overseeing Tuling and garrisoning the three eastern prefectures to supervise grain transport.
proposals.after: In the winter of 1363 he was made Garrison Commander of Shangdu and concurrently Prefect of Kaiping, promoted to Ronglu Grandee, and charged with overseeing Tuling and garrisoning the three eastern prefectures to supervise grain transport.
proposals.reason: 榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank (Grandee), not a physician title.

proposals.before: Before long Bolu Temür was executed in secret, Tujian Temür and the rest all fled in rout, and Shangdu was secure.
proposals.after: Before long Bolu Temür was put to death, Tujian Temür and the rest all fled in rout, and Shangdu was secure.
proposals.reason: 伏誅 means execution for crime or treason, not a clandestine killing; 'in secret' invents a sense absent from the Chinese.

decisions.after: Boyan soon had Yilianzhenban's son Dalima executed and banished Yilianzhenban to Hainan.
decisions.reason: The governing subject is Boyan, but 其子 refers to Yilianzhenban's son. The later family list explicitly identifies Dalima as the eldest of Yilianzhenban's nine sons.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 尋殺其子答裡麻，而謫置海南...子九人，長答裡麻

decisions.reason: The literal field must distinguish the two objects: Dalima is killed, while his father Yilianzhenban is exiled.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 尋殺其子答裡麻，而謫置海南...子九人，長答裡麻

decisions.after: Early in the Taiding reign he was promoted to the rank of Zishan Grandee and appointed Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Regalia.
decisions.reason: 資善大夫 is a civil prestige rank. Rendering 大夫 as 'Physician' confuses it with a medical office.

decisions.after: Early in the Zhishun reign he was appointed Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, granted the rank of Ronglu Grandee, and then made Commissioner of Meritorious Achievements, while retaining his command.
decisions.reason: 榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank rather than a medical title; the revision also distinguishes the rank from the surrounding offices.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 拜翰林學士承旨、榮祿大夫，遷功德使，指揮使如故

decisions.after: He was promoted to the rank of Zishan Grandee and appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
decisions.reason: 資善大夫 is a civil rank, while 江南行御史臺中丞 is the office to which he was appointed.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 轉資善大夫，拜江南行御史臺中丞

decisions.after: An edict promoted him to the first-rank grade of Ronglu Grandee.
decisions.reason: 榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank, and 進階一品 explicitly describes advancement to a first-rank grade.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 詔進階一品為榮祿大夫

decisions.after: In the winter of 1363 he was appointed Garrison Commander of Shangdu and concurrently Prefect of Kaiping, granted the rank of Ronglu Grandee, and assigned to Tuling to hold the three eastern prefectures and supervise supply transport.
decisions.reason: 榮祿大夫 is a prestige rank rather than a medical office. The sentence separately records his offices, detached assignment, defensive command, and transport duty.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遷上都留守，兼開平府尹，加榮祿大夫，分司土嶺，東鎮三州，以督轉輸

decisions.after: Before long Bolu Temür was executed, Tujian Temür and the others scattered in flight, and Shangdu was secure.
decisions.reason: 伏誅 is the conventional expression for suffering lawful or punitive execution; it does not mean that the killing was secret.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 孛羅帖木兒伏誅，禿堅帖木兒皆奔潰，而上都以安
